tests.label: Brightness rises steadily from left to right
A quarter of the way across is dark gray (0.25), not black

predict.question: `v` runs from −1 on the left to +1 on the right. At the pixel **a quarter of the way across**, v ≈ −0.5. What does the screen show there?
predict.explain: **Black.** The GPU clamps −0.5 to 0. The whole left half is "too dark to show". Inspect `v` to see that half hatched.
